breakdown.description: The load is extended from the intended partial top segment to the whole top boundary
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to fix the inconsistency. The ground truth prompt specifies that the vertical traction should be applied only on the partial top segment (0.3 <= x <= 0.5). The generated specification incorrectly instructs to apply the traction 'on the full top boundary segment from x=0.0 to x=0.8,' which repeats the error from the incomplete prompt.
